# ARKhives 8.21.5

ARKdaily now includes the 2,272 existing hints supplied for its Gravity question collection. Hint appears only when a supplied hint matches the current question and answer key. Clicking it plays Tiko's supplied hint animation and displays “Hint: ” followed by the original hint text.

The hint file's questions, answers and explanations are not imported. Existing source corrections, illustrations, explanations, personal progress, and review scheduling are preserved. The four trivia posts have no hint button. Saved questions with changed wording or keys cannot display a stale hint.

The small shared hint catalog is cached with the app. One catalog request serves the feed; questions do not make individual hint-generation calls or consume AI credits. The previously supplied Tiko artwork, animation engine, and sounds remain unchanged.

ARKdaily also responds directly to text-scale and theme/layout changes so the feed does not retain a stale height at enlarged desktop zoom. Account changes disconnect the layout observer.
